title: Film Academy Elevates Amy Homma to Oversee Collection in Addition to Museum (Exclusive)
summary: The organization also announced a host of new acquisitions including the screen-used bicycle from 'Pee-wee's Big Adventure,' rare Orson Welles scripts and correspondence, tap shoes worn by James Cagney in 'Yankee Doodle Dandy,' Edith Head's costume drawings for Kim Novak in 'Vertigo' and more.
tags: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
